title: How Does AI Sales Roleplay Work? A Practical Walkthrough
summary: Six steps: pick a call moment, write the buyer brief, run the call, score the transcript, choose one fix and retry. Plus what managers still decide.

Call stage, buyer, rep goal

2. Set buyer rules

Buyer brief


3. Run the conversation


Rep speech or text


Responds to the rep turn by turn

Audio and transcript


4. Score the attempt


Transcript and rubric

5. Choose one correction

6. Retry


Same moment with one change


Runs the pressure point again
